title: Hoshino Ichika — Our Route Ahead〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I know it's late, but there's something I'd like to ask you... Are you free to talk right now?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
<I can talk.
So, what is it that you wish to ask me?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I'd like to practice singing at a recording studio.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <I see. You'd like to practice in the same environment as when you recorded your debut song, yes...?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I did everything I could to sing well that time, and I managed to get your approval in the end...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I want to get better.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All four of us can work together on the instrumentals, but improving as a singer is something I need to do on my own...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Recreating the real thing is going to take a lot of time and preparation. Not to mention money...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <With that in mind, do you still wish to do this?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I know I'm asking a lot.
But please...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel so frustrated right now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It won't matter how well the others play if my singing doesn't cut it. And no one will understand our song's message.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We won't be able to accomplish our goal. We won't be able to move people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't want that to happen.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know this is going to involve a lot of preparation, but I'll figure something out for the studio's rental fee...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <It's not good to feel uncomfortable with recording, so we should nip this in the bud.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <I'll try booking the same studio as before.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Just think of it as a special measure. Also, I'll be there to watch as you practice...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <I wouldn't want you to push yourself too hard. Not only that...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Me being there should make it feel more like the real thing, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Hearing my voice through these headphones still feels really weird...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Wait, I know...
I should just imagine that I'm performing live.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Be it because of the instrumentals or the way the audience cheered for us, I remember plenty of times when I struggled to hear my own voice.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But at times like those, I believed in myself and everything I practiced, played my guitar...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And sang like I knew I could reach everyone's hearts.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Please! Can we try that again?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much for today, Mr. Shindo.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
And you seem to be feeling much better now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I really need to apologize.
If only I'd been able to sing like this on the day of the recording...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
The past is the past.
There's no point in worrying about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Not many people in this world can succeed 100% at something they've never done before.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Which is why I think you deserve a lot of credit for not giving up and hanging in there the way you did.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: How much you practiced, a song's difficulty level, how you feel that day, how well you gel with the staff and the studio environment...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Because of all those different factors, it's incredibly difficult to constantly perform in a way that you like.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, your job is to keep putting on the best performances you possibly can.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That's what it means to be a pro.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You're undoubtedly going to find yourself in uncomfortable or completely new situations in the future, but I'll be there to give you all the support I can.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, let's do our best together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I look forward to taking on those challenges with you!
